events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first broadcast video.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: On this day in 1981, MTV hit the airwaves, forever changing music and television. The first video? The ironically titled 'Video Killed The Radio Star' by The Buggles. Did it, though?

events.title: Oasis released 'Definitely Maybe'
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which became the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: Britpop Icon
angles.copy: 32 years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe', kicking off a Britpop revolution. Which track from their iconic debut still gets you going?

events.title: Woodstock Festival began
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music and Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, the Woodstock Festival opened its gates. Three days of peace, love, and iconic music that defined a generation. What's your favourite Woodstock moment?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: Today, we remember the one and only Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legacy continue to shake up the world.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, six days after being fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the enduring legacy of Tupac Shakur, who tragically left us in 1996. His powerful words and music still resonate today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon on this day in 1970. His electrifying guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Abbey Road'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, that tracklist... pure genius. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, fronting The Pretenders with undeniable style and attitude. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll energy. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine'
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album 'Imagine' in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon released the timeless 'Imagine'. A powerful message of peace and unity that still resonates globally. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: Apple launched the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod arrived 25 years ago? '1,000 songs in your pocket' changed everything for how we listen to music. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and all the iconic theme tunes that have accompanied his adventures over the decades. What's your favourite Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we celebrate what would have been the 86th birthday of the legendary John Lennon. His timeless music and message continue to inspire millions.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor and comedian John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us some of the most iconic comedy moments in history. What's your favourite?

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed their incredible range. Which track stands out for you?
